entities.name: Philip of Cleves, Lord of Ravenstein
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philip of Cleves, Lord of Ravenstein, Wijnendale and Enghien, was a nobleman from the Low Countries and army commander, first for Maximilian of Austria, then for Flemish rebels and the kingdom of France.
